species: Sizes are measured from the analysed assemblies. Other assembly versions of M. lepromatosis differ by tens of kilobases; the matched-size comparison in the text is stated against these accessions.

PGAP coding density is computed from the deposited protein set (sum of CDS nucleotide lengths, stop codons included, over assembly length); PGAP excludes pseudogenes from that set, where Prodigal calls the same decayed frames as genes. Against FSM at 93.6% the gap is 21-25 points on the uniform Prodigal calls and 33-41 points on the deposited annotation.
